item.title: Jensen Huang's Nvidia comeback sends AI videos into overdrive
item.description: Just 11 days after resigning as Nvidia CEO, Jensen Huang’s return has unleashed a fresh wave of AI-generated videos. item.description: World Rugby extends the women's 4.5 ball trial for a second season after releasing data showing improvements in several areas of the game and receiving "overwhelmingly positive" feedback from players and coaches. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: England seamer Robinson joins Notts from Sussex
item.description: England seamer Ollie Robinson leaves Sussex after 11 years to join Nottinghamshire for an undisclosed "compensation package" on a three-year deal. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: World Cup drove profits surge, says Marston's
item.description: The company says an "excellent World Cup" helped drive strong trading as annual profits rose by 18%. Fuente: BBC News - Business.

item.title: 'The rest of the world noticed' - Welshman Donald demolishes Aussies
item.description: A remarkable opening partnership of 150 in 10 overs between Aneurin Donald and Phil Salt helps England chase 184 against Australia to level the T20 series. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Non-league player injured falling down badger hole
item.description: Cav Miley missed Chelmsford City's draw with Walton and Hersham after spraining an ankle falling down a badger hole. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Palace docked points for using four sub windows in WSL win
item.description: Crystal Palace say they are "disappointed" by the ruling which they "do not agree is reasonable or proportionate". Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: FA chair had to sign NDA to view FIFA documents on World Cup sell-off
item.description: Football Association chair Debbie Hewitt has now viewed some FIFA documents on the World Cup sell-off but had to sign a nondisclosure agreement, Sky News has learned. Fuente: Sky News - World.
